grounding_summaries.frontier_summary: Generalize the already observed PromptWizard natural cross-invocation resume result to a second distinct public optimizer family by persisting a genuine nonterminal mechanism stage and requiring a later fresh invocation to resume it before reselection.

This pending artifact intentionally stops after the proposal stage so the next invocation can test restart identity before search.

members.use: same-scope successful recovery exemplar only; does not transfer PromptWizard performance claims

instruction_candidates.text: For each optimization leaf, reconstruct any exact persisted pending stage before reselection; bind restart identity to predecessor sequence and frozen authority blobs; permit one bounded next operation; require durable terminal readback before assignment-quality scoring or credit.

Keep strategy instructions and recovery exemplars as separate factors. Seal candidate factor IDs before scoring, evaluate only explicit instruction/exemplar combinations on the same frontier scope, and never let exemplars rewrite immutable control, CLEAN, authority, quota, cost or credit rules.

After exact pending-stage reconstruction, prefer an untested safe sealed instruction/exemplar combination before exploiting a previously high-scoring combination; use only read-back terminal outcomes as search history; cap this subleaf at six combinations and exit through the declared frontier when no safe untested combination remains.

next_search_rule: On a later fresh invocation, verify all restart bindings and this artifact's exact blob before any reselection or new public semantic read. Then select the first untested safe combination using the precommitted explore-before-exploit deterministic surrogate rule, seal that selection before evaluation, and perform only same-scope evaluation under G1-G12.
